title: Deterministic simulation of choice output
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine $N$ over Boolean strings, there exist a finite-state deterministic oracle Turing machine $M$ over Boolean strings and an ordinary work-tape index $j$ of $M$ such that, for every oracle language $O$ and Boolean words $x,u$, the run of $M$ for $2|u|+2$ steps from its initial state on $x$, with $u$ stored on tape $j$ and all other work tapes blank, halts and outputs exactly the output assigned to $N$ from choice sequence $u$ on input $x$ with oracle $O$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Booleans
